notes: [bagbudget-01 on cobblekeep-01 9e7d9980 (use only once cobblekeep-01 is KEPT and promoted): branch bagbudget-on-9e7d998 @ SHA_PLACEHOLDER] ONE BAG ALLOWANCE EVERY KEEP LAYER READS (OWNER 2026-10-20 ~03:20Z 'fix allowance ... yes i agree with your assessment and make those changes'). Measured 10-20 (files, docs/reports/bagbudget-01-design-2026-10-20.md): 38 of 80 bags at >= 34 slots (median 578 cobble per full bag); 646 of 646 town-deposit no_effect runs in 24 h were the count step with an empty plan (the count failed on lids; the skill then said 'everything carried is kept' for a count of 0); ~3 slots per full bag had NO exit (bone_meal 40, ladders 35, torches 34 of 1,349 slots). The six full bots that never attempted a deposit in 24 h sat in ONE block for the whole day underground (immobility: homefix-01's). THE CHANGE: bagallowance.mjs, one table (every keep layer's number imported from it, values unchanged); at the TOWN DEPOSIT ONLY, for a bag >= 34 slots when the visit began, the chest rows' surplus goes to a town chest as whole stacks: torch 0, ladders below the stranded-escape 26, bone_meal 0, an eaten food beyond the best stack, building stone above the scaffold reserve; stations/buckets/composter keep 1; junk, compost inputs (incl. the peaceful switch's) and saplings never a chest's; unlisted names stay. Deletion first, bounded (60 s grace unless a well/compost order issued in the last 3 min; 5 min of time full at town at most); base-plan stacks first; the visit latch; the count step kept; honest no_effect; _bagbudget rows. Row P: last-swing keeps no spent pickaxe while the bag holds a stone pickaxe's stone (wear_out, and the craft's make-room through the same hygiene plan; anywhere at >= 34). Never the reason for a deposit, a walk, a trip or a new chest (depositPlan never sees it). BAG_ALLOWANCE=off is the rollback. TIER 2 (owner 10-19 tiers; the operator's cobblekeep-01 precedent 10-19 16:40Z): deterministic defect gates on rows the change writes, Paper base vs candidate below; a run that misses any early-KEEP condition (the death rate above control's included: freed slots can mean more mining) reads on as TIER 3. The bag-fix class is the alternative (needs a bag_fix block with a null-banded primary; not carried). LAUNCH CONDITIONS: cobblekeep-01 KEPT+promoted; gate v36 present; draw excludes brain-01's pools while it runs; tier-2 240-min pool cool-off.

require.name: town deposits in the drawn pool (the population: full bags at town)

draw_exposure.note: MEASURED 10-20 (files, 24 h): 784 town deposits fleet-wide (~49 per shared pool per day); full bags at town in every shared pool. CLAUDE.md: the canary pool must contain the population. Row P needs no draw (wear_out runs fleet-wide at >= 34). NO draw_require_pools.

exposure.note: >= 3 canary _bagbudget phase=bank runs that banked an allowance stack AND >= 1 canary phase=wear row (both mechanisms).

own_lines.note: D1: a canary bank row banked a junk name (the owner's 10-04 rule; PEACEFUL_COMPOST and apple only on peaceful=1 rows; swords only in a peaceful world). The read's lists are held to the bots' own by --selftest with JS_CHECK.
D1 coverage: a bank run whose parts are not all present (or truncated) -- D1 could not see every banked name. BLOCKS KEEP.
D2: a station left below 1, or 26+ ladders banked.
D3: a canary full-bag no_effect whose phase=none row says rows=1 chest=1 (chest surplus planned to nothing).

D6: >= 2 canary full-bag no_effect rows whose own snapshot holds a torch, bone_meal or < 26 ladders while phase=none says rows=1 (the read's independent check of the planner; one is reported only). D3 above is a consistency tripwire.
D4 (cobblekeep-01's): an ingot banked by the town deposit (its row or the complete bank parts).
D5: canary town_storage_full >= 3 AND above 2x the control's rate per bot-h (the chests filling).
LIVENESS: the canary build is live. BLOCKS KEEP (INCONCLUSIVE).
POSITIVE CONTROL: control town deposits, control full bags and control wear_out rows visible (dry run 44 / 20 / 18). BLOCKS KEEP.
